title: PDAC BioPortal: An Integrated Multi-Scale Framework for Context-Aware Analysis of Pancreatic Cancer Transcriptomics
description:
PDAC BioPortal (featuring PDACopilot) is an open-access multi-scale pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) transcriptomics and translational knowledgebase.

Live Portal: https://limboper89.github.io/PAAD-SBRT-GEx-Dashboard/
Source Code Repository: https://github.com/Limboper89/PAAD-SBRT-GEx-Dashboard

The platform harmonizes four complementary human PDAC transcriptomic cohorts:

  • TCGA-PAAD vs GTEx Normal Pancreas (n=349: 178 primary tumors, 167 GTEx normal pancreas, 4 solid tissue normals; UCSC Xena Toil recompute)
  • GSE225767: Neoadjuvant stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) bulk RNA-seq cohort (n=55: 26 pre-treatment FNA biopsies, 29 post-treatment surgical resections)
  • GSE202051: Single-nucleus RNA-seq reference atlas (224,988 nuclei across 43 patients)
  • GSE274103: 10x Genomics Visium spatial transcriptomics (23,436 spots across 5 clinical sections with H&E histology overlay)
